description: This file defines a calculate function for handling calculator button inputs, updating the calculator's state including total, next number, and current operation. It manages operations like clear, number input, percentage, decimal point, equals, and sign change, utilizing external modules 'operate', 'isNumber', and 'big.js' for calculations and input validation.

methods.name: calculate(obj, buttonName)
methods.description: Main function executing calculator logic based on button pressed, updating internal calculator state accordingly.
